scope: Two-character bounded smoke cohort: 白 and 百, separate graph identities and separate entries.

scan_budget.policy: Use at most three distinct 字源 original scan pages for each character in initial research, including continuation pages. Prefer the actual headword and only directly relevant continuation/comparator pages. Do not do whole-book searches, OCR, rendering or visual sweeps.

白: Inspect the actual 白 headword and any immediately relevant continuation within the three-page cap. Verify the printed identity, printed/PDF page labels, named components, readings, and any historical-form claims against scan pixels.

The canonical entry also lists meanings beyond “white” (伯, place name, hundred, pure/unblemished, bright). Consult current authoritative Mandarin references independently; scope meanings by evidence and do not carry over character-history claims to unrelated senses. Determine whether “百” used as a value/sense in this separate entry requires an explicit relation and whether it is supported.

Compare the book’s account with authoritative paleographic/dictionary sources; preserve competing graph readings. Do not infer image identities, components, sound roles, or semantic history from familiar shapes.
百: Inspect the actual 百 headword and any immediately relevant continuation within the three-page cap. Verify printed identity, printed/PDF page labels, the one-hundred/large-quantity sense distinctions, and historical-form claims against scan pixels.

The canonical entry describes disputed early construction (top marker above 白-like base versus 一 plus 白). Check precisely what the book claims and whether it treats the graph as compound/pictorial; compare authoritative paleographic/dictionary sources. Do not force a single analysis or treat modern strokes as historic component roles.

Consult current authoritative Mandarin references for current meanings/status. Keep attested meanings distinct from proposed original meanings; do not infer that 白 is a semantic or phonetic component without direct source support.

general_requirements: Use repository sources, the registered digitized book, and additional authoritative sources. Keep book evidence page-specific and cite only claims it supports.

If the headword cannot be identified or a printed glyph is ambiguous, retain a page-bound glyph identity and precise gap; do not guess or normalize OCR. If a literal OCR error seems likely, report the exact raw span and original page/pixel evidence as a proposal, without changing producer data.

Never edit canonical articles/dossiers or repository source prose in the research role; do not create GitHub issues or perform git operations. Preserve prior evidence unless a verified correction requires review.

Research and reviews must use gpt-6-luna with low reasoning. The exact current article and dossier must receive fresh independent factual and readability approvals. Preserve current supported claims, uncertainty and citations.
